name: oido-shopify
description: Build and run a Shopify store from empty to production — theme, catalog, collections, pages, navigation, policies, shipping, discounts, orders, fulfillment and customers — via MCP, using the Admin GraphQL API (Dev Dashboard client credentials, or a legacy custom-app token).

settings.name: SHOPIFY_STORE
settings.description: Store domain, e.g. acme.myshopify.com (the permanent myshopify.com domain, not a custom domain)

settings.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: Client ID of your Dev Dashboard app (dev.shopify.com → app → Settings). The app and store must be in the same Shopify organization.

settings.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
settings.description: Client secret of your Dev Dashboard app

settings.name: SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
settings.description: Only for an existing legacy admin-created custom app: its Admin API token (shpat_…). Leave empty when using client ID/secret.

settings.name: SHOPIFY_API_VERSION
settings.description: Admin API version, e.g. 2026-07. Leave empty for the plugin default.
